+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Short raw/cached identity gates with local repair disabled and enabled.
+
+Run only after coordinating GPU scheduling. Four24x4x24,0.35day processes;
+separate output folders preserve all raw parent controls and physical sources.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+import datetime as dt
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+CUDA=ROOT/'solver/cuda';OUT=CUDA/'validation/cached_local'
+PARENT=CUDA/'mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld_local';CACHED=CUDA/'mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld_local_cached'
+
+def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+def read(path):return dict(line.split('=',1) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if '=' in line)
+
+def run(values,name,binary):
+    folder=OUT/name;config=OUT/(name+'.cfg')
+    config.write_text(''.join(f'{key}={value}\n' for key,value in {**values,'output_dir':folder}.items()))
+    with (OUT/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
+        subprocess.run(['nice','-n','15',str(binary),'--config',str(config)],stdout=log,stderr=log,check=True,timeout=90)
+    return folder
+
+def compare(parent,cached):
+    names=['probe.csv','snapshots.csv','r_au.npy','theta_rad.npy','phi_rad.npy','step_histogram.csv','hlld_fallbacks.json','local_repair.json','local_repair_histogram.csv','boundary_thermo_metadata.json']
+    names.extend(p.name for p in sorted(parent.glob('snapshot_*.npy')))
+    same={name:(parent/name).read_bytes()==(cached/name).read_bytes() for name in names}
+    a=json.loads((parent/'statistics.json').read_text());b=json.loads((cached/'statistics.json').read_text())
+    keys=['steps','rejected_steps','first_order_fallback_steps','minimum_dt_day','mean_dimensionless_divB','max_dimensionless_divB','weighted_dimensionless_divB']
+    same.update({key:a[key]==b[key] for key in keys})
+    assert all(same.values()),same
+    storage=round((b['device_allocated_MB']-a['device_allocated_MB'])*1e6)
+    assert storage==24,storage
+    return {'all_required_outputs_bit_identical':True,'identity_checks':same,'parent_statistics':a,'cached_statistics':b,'device_storage_increase_bytes':storage,'parent_wall_over_cached_wall':a['wall_seconds']/b['wall_seconds'],'local_repair':json.loads((cached/'local_repair.json').read_text()),'parent_output_sha256':{name:sha(parent/name) for name in names},'cached_output_sha256':{name:sha(cached/name) for name in names}}
+
+def main():
+    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
+    values=read(CUDA/'validation/hlld_thermo_coarse_fp32.cfg')
+    values.update(nr=24,ntheta=4,nphi=24,start_day=32,end_day=32.35,output_start_day=32,snapshot_days=.1,probes_csv=ROOT/'inputs/probes_5min.csv')
+    report={'created_utc':dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Scheduling identity only; local repair physics is frozen to raw parent. No precision/convergence claim.','parent_binary_sha256':sha(PARENT),'cached_binary_sha256':sha(CACHED),'cases':{}}
+    for flag,label in [(0,'disabled'),(1,'enabled')]:
+        config={**values,'local_positivity_repair':flag}
+        parent=run(config,label+'_parent',PARENT);cached=run(config,label+'_cached',CACHED)
+        record=compare(parent,cached)
+        if flag:assert record['local_repair']['accepted_local_repair_steps']>0,'Enabled fixture did not exercise local repair'
+        report['cases'][label]=record
+        (OUT/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
+        print(label,json.dumps({'identical':True,'steps':record['cached_statistics']['steps'],'repaired_steps':record['local_repair']['accepted_local_repair_steps'],'global_fallbacks':record['cached_statistics']['first_order_fallback_steps'],'wall_ratio':record['parent_wall_over_cached_wall']}),flush=True)
+    provenance=json.loads((CUDA/'mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld_local_cached_provenance.json').read_text())
+    for path,value in provenance['parent_sources'].items():assert sha(ROOT/path)==value,path
+    print('All frozen source/helper hashes unchanged; saved',OUT/'verification.json',flush=True)
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()
